        && get(published ? /databases/$(database)/documents/publishedContent/$(version)/groups/types-0 : /databases/$(database)/documents/draftContent/$(request.auth.uid)/versions/$(version)/groups/types-0).data.records == r.get("types", {})

    function payloadHeader(p) {
      return p is map && p.keys().hasOnly(['version', 'changes']) && p.version == 1
        && p.changes is map && p.changes.keys().hasOnly(["products","categories","types","worlds","guides","blocks","pages"])
        && known_products(p.changes.get("products", {}))
        && known_categories(p.changes.get("categories", {}))
        && known_types(p.changes.get("types", {}))
        && known_worlds(p.changes.get("worlds", {}))
        && known_guides(p.changes.get("guides", {}))
        && known_blocks(p.changes.get("blocks", {}))
        && known_pages(p.changes.get("pages", {}));
    }
    function groupData(group, records, published) {
      let pattern = published ? '(|spark:published/[a-f0-9-]{36}/[a-f0-9-]{36})'
        : '(|spark:published/[a-f0-9-]{36}/[a-f0-9-]{36}|spark:drafts/' + request.auth.uid + '/[a-f0-9-]{36})';
      return (group in ["products-0","products-1","products-2","products-3","products-4","products-5","products-6","products-7","products-8","products-9","products-10","products-11","products-12","products-13","products-14","products-15","products-16","products-17","products-18","products-19","products-20","products-21","products-22","products-23","products-24","products-25"] ? (group in ["products-0","products-1","products-2","products-3","products-4","products-5","products-6","products-7","products-8","products-9","products-10","products-11","products-12"] ? (group in ["products-0","products-1","products-2","products-3","products-4","products-5","products-6"] ? (group in ["products-0","products-1","products-2","products-3"] ? (group in ["products-0","products-1"] ? (group in ["products-0"] ? (group == "products-0" && chunk_products_0(records, published, pattern)) : (group == "products-1" && chunk_products_1(records, published, pattern))) : (group in ["products-2"] ? (group == "products-2" && chunk_products_2(records, published, pattern)) : (group == "products-3" && chunk_products_3(records, published, pattern)))) : (group in ["products-4","products-5"] ? (group in ["products-4"] ? (group == "products-4" && chunk_products_4(records, published, pattern)) : (group == "products-5" && chunk_products_5(records, published, pattern))) : (group == "products-6" && chunk_products_6(records, published, pattern)))) : (group in ["products-7","products-8","products-9"] ? (group in ["products-7","products-8"] ? (group in ["products-7"] ? (group == "products-7" && chunk_products_7(records, published, pattern)) : (group == "products-8" && chunk_products_8(records, published, pattern))) : (group == "products-9" && chunk_products_9(records, published, pattern))) : (group in ["products-10","products-11"] ? (group in ["products-10"] ? (group == "products-10" && chunk_products_10(records, published, pattern)) : (group == "products-11" && chunk_products_11(records, published, pattern))) : (group == "products-12" && chunk_products_12(records, published, pattern))))) : (group in ["products-13","products-14","products-15","products-16","products-17","products-18","products-19"] ? (group in ["products-13","products-14","products-15","products-16"] ? (group in ["products-13","products-14"] ? (group in ["products-13"] ? (group == "products-13" && chunk_products_13(records, published, pattern)) : (group == "products-14" && chunk_products_14(records, published, pattern))) : (group in ["products-15"] ? (group == "products-15" && chunk_products_15(records, published, pattern)) : (group == "products-16" && chunk_products_16(records, published, pattern)))) : (group in ["products-17","products-18"] ? (group in ["products-17"] ? (group == "products-17" && chunk_products_17(records, published, pattern)) : (group == "products-18" && chunk_products_18(records, published, pattern))) : (group == "products-19" && chunk_products_19(records, published, pattern)))) : (group in ["products-20","products-21","products-22"] ? (group in ["products-20","products-21"] ? (group in ["products-20"] ? (group == "products-20" && chunk_products_20(records, published, pattern)) : (group == "products-21" && chunk_products_21(records, published, pattern))) : (group == "products-22" && chunk_products_22(records, published, pattern))) : (group in ["products-23","products-24"] ? (group in ["products-23"] ? (group == "products-23" && chunk_products_23(records, published, pattern)) : (group == "products-24" && chunk_products_24(records, published, pattern))) : (group == "products-25" && chunk_products_25(records, published, pattern)))))) : (group in ["products-26","products-27","products-28","products-29","products-30","products-31","products-32","products-33","products-34","products-35","products-36","products-37","products-38"] ? (group in ["products-26","products-27","products-28","products-29","products-30","products-31","products-32"] ? (group in ["products-26","products-27","products-28","products-29"] ? (group in ["products-26","products-27"] ? (group in ["products-26"] ? (group == "products-26" && chunk_products_26(records, published, pattern)) : (group == "products-27" && chunk_products_27(records, published, pattern))) : (group in ["products-28"] ? (group == "products-28" && chunk_products_28(records, published, pattern)) : (group == "products-29" && chunk_products_29(records, published, pattern)))) : (group in ["products-30","products-31"] ? (group in ["products-30"] ? (group == "products-30" && chunk_products_30(records, published, pattern)) : (group == "products-31" && chunk_products_31(records, published, pattern))) : (group == "products-32" && chunk_products_32(records, published, pattern)))) : (group in ["products-33","products-34","products-35"] ? (group in ["products-33","products-34"] ? (group in ["products-33"] ? (group == "products-33" && chunk_products_33(records, published, pattern)) : (group == "products-34" && chunk_products_34(records, published, pattern))) : (group == "products-35" && chunk_products_35(records, published, pattern))) : (group in ["products-36","products-37"] ? (group in ["products-36"] ? (group == "products-36" && chunk_products_36(records, published, pattern)) : (group == "products-37" && chunk_products_37(records, published, pattern))) : (group == "products-38" && chunk_products_38(records, published, pattern))))) : (group in ["products-39","products-40","products-41","products-42","products-43","products-44","categories-0"] ? (group in ["products-39","products-40","products-41","products-42"] ? (group in ["products-39","products-40"] ? (group in ["products-39"] ? (group == "products-39" && chunk_products_39(records, published, pattern)) : (group == "products-40" && chunk_products_40(records, published, pattern))) : (group in ["products-41"] ? (group == "products-41" && chunk_products_41(records, published, pattern)) : (group == "products-42" && chunk_products_42(records, published, pattern)))) : (group in ["products-43","products-44"] ? (group in ["products-43"] ? (group == "products-43" && chunk_products_43(records, published, pattern)) : (group == "products-44" && chunk_products_44(records, published, pattern))) : (group == "categories-0" && chunk_categories_0(records, published, pattern)))) : (group in ["types-0","worlds-0","guides-0"] ? (group in ["types-0","worlds-0"] ? (group in ["types-0"] ? (group == "types-0" && chunk_types_0(records, published, pattern)) : (group == "worlds-0" && chunk_worlds_0(records, published, pattern))) : (group == "guides-0" && chunk_guides_0(records, published, pattern))) : (group in ["blocks-0","pages-0"] ? (group in ["blocks-0"] ? (group == "blocks-0" && chunk_blocks_0(records, published, pattern)) : (group == "pages-0" && chunk_pages_0(records, published, pattern))) : (group == "pages-1" && chunk_pages_1(records, published, pattern)))))));
    }
    function draftEnvelope() {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.keys().hasOnly(['payload', 'revision', 'draftId', 'updatedAt', 'updatedBy'])
        && d.revision is int && d.updatedBy == request.auth.uid && d.updatedAt == request.time
        && uuid(d.draftId) && payloadHeader(d.payload)
        && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/draftContent/$(request.auth.uid)/versions/$(d.draftId)/proofs/products-proof-0).data.records == {"products": d.payload.changes.get("products", {})}
        && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/draftContent/$(request.auth.uid)/versions/$(d.draftId)/proofs/products-proof-1).data.records == {"products": d.payload.changes.get("products", {})}
        && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/draftContent/$(request.auth.uid)/versions/$(d.draftId)/proofs/products-proof-2).data.records == {"products": d.payload.changes.get("products", {})}
        && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/draftContent/$(request.auth.uid)/versions/$(d.draftId)/proofs/products-proof-3).data.records == {"products": d.payload.changes.get("products", {})}
        && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/draftContent/$(request.auth.uid)/versions/$(d.draftId)/proofs/products-proof-4).data.records == {"products": d.payload.changes.get("products", {})}
        && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/draftContent/$(request.auth.uid)/versions/$(d.draftId)/proofs/products-proof-5).data.records == {"products": d.payload.changes.get("products", {})}
        && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/draftContent/$(request.auth.uid)/versions/$(d.draftId)/proofs/other-proof-0).data.records == {"categories": d.payload.changes.get("categories", {}), "types": d.payload.changes.get("types", {}), "worlds": d.payload.changes.get("worlds", {}), "guides": d.payload.changes.get("guides", {}), "blocks": d.payload.changes.get("blocks", {}), "pages": d.payload.changes.get("pages", {})};
    }
    function publicEnvelope() {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      let release = getAfter(/databases/$(database)/documents/mediaReleases/$(d.revisionId)).data;
      return d.keys().hasOnly(['payload', 'revision', 'revisionId', 'updatedAt'])
        && d.revision is int && uuid(d.revisionId) && d.updatedAt == request.time
        && payloadHeader(d.payload) && release.revision == d.revision
        && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/publishedContent/$(d.revisionId)/proofs/products-proof-0).data.records == {"products": d.payload.changes.get("products", {})}
        && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/publishedContent/$(d.revisionId)/proofs/products-proof-1).data.records == {"products": d.payload.changes.get("products", {})}
        && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/publishedContent/$(d.revisionId)/proofs/products-proof-2).data.records == {"products": d.payload.changes.get("products", {})}
        && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/publishedContent/$(d.revisionId)/proofs/products-proof-3).data.records == {"products": d.payload.changes.get("products", {})}
        && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/publishedContent/$(d.revisionId)/proofs/products-proof-4).data.records == {"products": d.payload.changes.get("products", {})}
        && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/publishedContent/$(d.revisionId)/proofs/products-proof-5).data.records == {"products": d.payload.changes.get("products", {})}
        && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/publishedContent/$(d.revisionId)/proofs/other-proof-0).data.records == {"categories": d.payload.changes.get("categories", {}), "types": d.payload.changes.get("types", {}), "worlds": d.payload.changes.get("worlds", {}), "guides": d.payload.changes.get("guides", {}), "blocks": d.payload.changes.get("blocks", {}), "pages": d.payload.changes.get("pages", {})};
    }
    function proofData(proof, records, version, published) {
      return (proof == "products-proof-0" && proof_products_proof_0(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "products-proof-1" && proof_products_proof_1(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "products-proof-2" && proof_products_proof_2(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "products-proof-3" && proof_products_proof_3(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "products-proof-4" && proof_products_proof_4(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "products-proof-5" && proof_products_proof_5(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "other-proof-0" && proof_other_proof_0(records, version, published));
    }
    function imageData() {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.bytes is bytes && d.bytes.size() > 0 && d.bytes.size() <= 196608
        && d.mime == 'image/webp' && d.createdAt == request.time;
    }
    match /admins/{uid} {
      allow get: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == uid;
      allow list, write: if false;
    }
    match /cms/draft {
      allow read: if owner();
      allow create: if owner() && draftEnvelope() && request.resource.data.revision == 1;
      allow update: if owner() && draftEnvelope() && request.resource.data.revision == resource.data.revision + 1;
      allow delete: if false;
    }
    match /draftContent/{uid}/versions/{version}/groups/{group} {
      allow read: if owner() && request.auth.uid == uid;
      allow create: if owner() && request.auth.uid == uid && uuid(version)
        && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['records', 'createdAt'])
        && request.resource.data.createdAt == request.time
        && groupData(group, request.resource.data.records, false);
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /draftContent/{uid}/versions/{version}/proofs/{proof} {
      allow read: if owner() && request.auth.uid == uid;
      allow create: if owner() && request.auth.uid == uid && uuid(version)
        && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['records', 'createdAt'])
        && request.resource.data.createdAt == request.time
        && proofData(proof, request.resource.data.records, version, false);
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /publishedContent/{release}/proofs/{proof} {
      allow read: if exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/mediaReleases/$(release));
      allow create: if owner() && uuid(release)
        && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['records', 'createdAt'])
        && request.resource.data.createdAt == request.time
        && proofData(proof, request.resource.data.records, release, true)
        && !exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/mediaReleases/$(release));
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /publishedContent/{release}/groups/{group} {
      allow read: if exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/mediaReleases/$(release));
      allow create: if owner() && uuid(release)
        && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['records', 'createdAt'])
        && request.resource.data.createdAt == request.time
        && groupData(group, request.resource.data.records, true)
        && !exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/mediaReleases/$(release));
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /public/site {
      allow read: if true;
      allow create: if owner() && publicEnvelope() && request.resource.data.revision == 1;
      allow update: if owner() && publicEnvelope() && request.resource.data.revision == resource.data.revision + 1;
      allow delete: if false;
    }
    match /revisions/{id} {
      allow read: if owner();
      allow create: if owner()
        && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['payload', 'revision', 'createdAt', 'kind'])
        && request.resource.data.createdAt == request.time
        && ((id == 'initial' && !exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/public/site)
          && getAfter(/databases/$(database)/documents/public/site).data.revision == 1
          && request.resource.data.revision == 0 && request.resource.data.kind == 'initial'
          && request.resource.data.payload == {'version': 1, 'changes': {}})
        || (uuid(id) && request.resource.data.kind in ['publish', 'restore']
          && getAfter(/databases/$(database)/documents/public/site).data.revisionId == id
          && getAfter(/databases/$(database)/documents/public/site).data.revision == request.resource.data.revision
          && getAfter(/databases/$(database)/documents/public/site).data.payload == request.resource.data.payload));
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /mediaReleases/{id} {
      allow read: if owner();
      allow create: if owner() && uuid(id)
        && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['revision', 'createdAt'])
        && request.resource.data.createdAt == request.time
        && getAfter(/databases/$(database)/documents/public/site).data.revisionId == id
        && getAfter(/databases/$(database)/documents/public/site).data.revision == request.resource.data.revision
        && getAfter(/databases/$(database)/documents/revisions/$(id)).data.revision == request.resource.data.revision
        && getAfter(/databases/$(database)/documents/revisions/$(id)).data.payload == getAfter(/databases/$(database)/documents/public/site).data.payload;
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /draftImages/{uid}/images/{id} {
      allow read: if owner() && request.auth.uid == uid;
      allow create: if owner() && request.auth.uid == uid && uuid(id) && imageData()
        && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['bytes', 'mime', 'createdAt']);
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /publishedImages/{release}/images/{id} {
      allow read: if exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/mediaReleases/$(release));
      allow create: if owner() && uuid(release) && uuid(id) && imageData()
        && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['bytes', 'mime', 'sourceId', 'createdAt'])
        && uuid(request.resource.data.sourceId)
        && !exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/mediaReleases/$(release))
        && request.resource.data.bytes == get(/databases/$(database)/documents/draftImages/$(request.auth.uid)/images/$(request.resource.data.sourceId)).data.bytes;
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /{document=**} { allow read, write: if false; }
  }
}
